content:
The countdown to Apple's annual September keynote has reached fever pitch. With consumer interest surging across New Delhi, London, and New York, the upcoming iPhone 17 generation is shaping up to be Cupertino's most consequential hardware pivot in half a decade. Between the retirement of the Plus line, the debut of an ultra-thin "Air" chassis, and the long-awaited expansion of 120Hz ProMotion across the entire family, buyers in India, the US, and the UK have plenty to calculate.

Apple September 2026 Event: What to Expect

Every September, the consumer technology calendar revolves around Apple's flagship hardware unveiling. The 2026 keynote promises to double down on deep hardware-software integration powered by Apple Intelligence 2.0. Rather than relying on incremental design tweaks, Apple is overhauling its device tiers to cater directly to evolving consumer preferences across international markets.

Key highlights slated for the keynote include:

  • Unified 120Hz Displays: The end of 60Hz panels on baseline consumer flagships, ensuring identical scroll fluidity from entry tier to Pro Max.
  • Second-Generation 3nm Silicon: The A19 and A19 Pro processors offering double-digit neural engine speed gains and refined thermal throttle management.
  • Advanced Anti-Reflective Glass: A scratch-resistant ceramic formulation that substantially cuts outdoor glare in sunny environments.
  • Upgraded Selfies: A new 24MP front-facing sensor featuring 6-element plastic optics and enhanced square crop stabilization across all variants.

The Lineup: Introducing the iPhone 17 Air

For the past four years, Apple struggled to find a sweet spot with its secondary baseline phone. The mini lacked battery endurance, while the Plus failed to capture volume from buyers who preferred either the base model or the flagship Pro Max. In 2026, Apple is executing a radical repositioning with the iPhone 17 Air (often cited as the iPhone Slim in early supply chain dispatches).

Measuring an astonishing 5.5mm in thickness, the iPhone 17 Air represents Apple's most radical structural engineering feat since the iPad Pro M4. Built on an aluminum-titanium hybrid frame, it delivers a 6.6-inch display while weighing significantly less than traditional flagships. To achieve this featherweight profile, the Air houses a single high-resolution 48MP Fusion sensor backed by computational zoom algorithms, catering to design-forward buyers who prioritize ergonomics over triple-lens camera bumps.

A19 Pro Chip, 120Hz Displays & Camera Upgrades

Under the hood, the entire iPhone 17 lineup benefits from TSMC's refined N3P 3-nanometer fabrication node. The standard iPhone 17 and iPhone 17 Air adopt the base A19 chip with 8GB of unified memory, while the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max receive the A19 Pro paired with 12GB of high-speed LPDDR5X RAM.

This 12GB memory footprint on Pro models is not just for gaming bragging rights; it provides the dedicated operational headroom required for on-device Apple Intelligence models, including complex local document synthesis, real-time audio translation, and multimodal vision processing.

Why Do India and the UK Pay More for iPhones?

A perennial question among tech enthusiasts in India and Britain is why the same device costs substantially more than its sticker price in California or Delaware. The divergence stems from three primary economic components:

  1. Taxation Transparency: In the United States, retail prices are published before state sales tax (which ranges between 0% in Oregon to ~9.5% in parts of California and Tennessee). In contrast, UK prices mandate a statutory 20% Value Added Tax (VAT), and India includes an 18% Goods and Services Tax (GST). Check your total tax burden using our GST Calculator.
  2. Import Duties & Domestic Assembly: While Apple has scaled local assembly of base iPhone models in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, high-end Pro and Pro Max enclosures and periscope camera assemblies still incur component import tariffs.
  3. Currency Hedging Buffers: Multi-national hardware manufacturers bake in 3% to 6% forex volatility reserves to protect against foreign exchange swings over a 12-month product lifecycle.

Pre-Orders and Official Release Timelines

Historically, Apple adheres to an exact release choreography. Here is how the September 2026 launch calendar aligns across major global timezones:

  • Official Keynote Announcement: Tuesday, September 8, 2026 (10:00 AM PT / 6:00 PM BST / 10:30 PM IST).
  • Pre-Orders Open: Friday, September 11, 2026 (5:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM BST / 5:30 PM IST).
  • In-Store Retail Availability: Friday, September 18, 2026 across Apple Store Fifth Avenue (NYC), Regent Street (London), BKC (Mumbai), and Saket (Delhi).

Should You Upgrade to the iPhone 17?

If you are currently holding an iPhone 15 or older device, the jump to the iPhone 17 is substantial. The combination of a silky-smooth 120Hz ProMotion panel on every model, double-digit battery life gains via TSMC's refined 3nm nodes, and native on-device Apple Intelligence makes 2026 an ideal refresh year. However, if you already own an iPhone 16 Pro, the incremental processor boost alone may not warrant an immediate trade-in unless the ultra-thin form factor of the iPhone 17 Air catches your eye.

Cricket fever is back at peak intensity across the subcontinent and throughout the vast diaspora communities of North America and Great Britain. The Asia Cup 2026 brings together regional powerhouses India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Afghanistan, and tournament qualifiers in a high-octane T20 competition. With matches hosted in the United Arab Emirates under state-of-the-art floodlights, millions of cricket fans in India, the US, and the UK are gearing up for high-stakes rivalries, last-over finishes, and unforgettable individual heroics.

Asia Cup 2026: Tournament Format & Host Venues

Governed by the Asian Cricket Council (ACC), the 2026 edition features six nations divided into two competitive pools of three teams each. The top two teams from Group A and Group B advance to the Super Four stage, where each nation plays every other qualifying opponent in a round-robin format before the top two battle in the Grand Final.

Hosted across the iconic floodlit arenas of the United Arab Emirates—the Dubai International Cricket Stadium with its signature "Ring of Fire" roof lighting and the historic, short-boundary Sharjah Cricket Stadium—the tournament delivers an electric atmosphere and world-class sporting infrastructure.

  • Group A: India, Pakistan, UAE (Qualifier)
  • Group B: Sri Lanka, Afghanistan, Bangladesh

Because each group contains three teams and only the bottom team is eliminated, every single game carries immense net run rate (NRR) significance. A slow start in match one can leave a powerhouse side on the brink of an early flight home.

No contest in world sport commands broader viewership than an India-Pakistan cricket clash. With an estimated global television and digital audience exceeding 400 million, the September 13 group stage showdown in Dubai is the commercial and emotional epicenter of the tournament.

The duel centers on India's top-order aggression against Pakistan's express pace attack led by Shaheen Shah Afridi and Naseem Shah. On Dubai's responsive drop-in pitches, the tactical battle during the 6-over powerplay often dictates the entire game script. India's left-right combination of Jaiswal and Gill will look to neutralize the moving new ball, setting a platform for middle-overs dominance by Suryakumar and Rishabh Pant.

Pitch Conditions: Spin Factors in Dubai & Sharjah

Conditions in the UAE change notably as tournaments progress. In Dubai, large boundary dimensions reward disciplined length bowling and athletic boundary-riding fielders. Teams batting first will aim for 175-185 as a par score. In contrast, Sharjah's intimate 60-meter boundaries produce six-hitting festivals where mis-hits frequently sail over the roof into adjacent streets.

During the latter half of the tournament, pitch wear will elevate the role of wrist spinners like Kuldeep Yadav and Rashid Khan. The dew factor in September evening matches also plays a crucial role; captains winning the toss will almost universally elect to bowl first, chasing down totals with a slicker, easier-to-grip ball during the second innings.

Under the electric night lights of Arthur Ashe Stadium in Queens, the US Open 2026 has delivered another unforgettable fortnight of hardcourt drama. As the final Grand Slam of the 2026 tennis calendar, Flushing Meadows crowned new champions, minted record prize money figures, and cemented generational rivalries that will define the sport for the next decade. From roaring sellout crowds in New York to bleary-eyed fans streaming matches in London and Mumbai, tennis enthusiasts were treated to an all-time classic tournament.

US Open 2026: New York Grand Slam Wrap-Up

From late-night five-set marathons that stretched past 2:00 AM Eastern Time to blistering daytime humidity, the 2026 US Open tested physical and mental conditioning to the absolute limit. With faster court surfaces installed across the outer courts and enhanced video-review technology on every line call, the standard of baseline shot-making reached dizzying heights.

Fans across North America, the United Kingdom, and the Indian subcontinent tuned in by the millions as the championship matches pitted established modern greats against fearless breakout stars. The high-energy, rowdy New York crowds added an unmistakable sensory pulse, demanding that players maintain mental composure while navigating roaring planes taking off from nearby LaGuardia Airport.

Men's Singles Final: Epic Showdown on Arthur Ashe

The Men's Singles final delivered the box-office blockbuster the tennis world craved: a four-set masterclass showcasing explosive baseline firepower, feather-touch drop shots, and supersonic serving. With the Arthur Ashe Stadium roof closed amidst evening showers, the indoor acoustic resonance magnified every roar from the 23,000 spectators in attendance.

Dominating from the back of the court with heavy topspin forehands and an improved 82% first-serve win rate, the newly crowned champion closed out the title 6-4, 3-6, 7-6 (7-3), 6-2 in three hours and forty-two minutes. Key turning points came in the crucial third-set tiebreak, where clinical return winners against 130 mph deliveries broke open an otherwise deadlocked war of baseline attrition.

Women's Singles Championship: Historic Victory

The Women's Singles draw culminated in a breathtaking clash of contrasting playing styles. On one side stood relentless defensive counterpunching and court coverage; on the other, raw baseline velocity capable of producing clean winners off either wing.

In a dramatic second set tiebreaker that kept the New York crowd on its feet, the eventual champion saved three set points before executing a crisp backhand down-the-line winner to take the title in straight sets: 7-5, 7-6 (7-4). The triumph marks their second major title of 2026, sparking jubilant celebrations across international fan bases and confirming their ascendancy as a dominant world number one.

Doubles Crowns & Diaspora Performances

The doubles draws held special significance for international supporters. British doubles specialists reached the championship weekend in both Men's and Mixed categories, exhibiting trademark tactical net craft, angled reflex volleys, and strategic court positioning.

For Indian tennis fans, the tournament underscored the enduring legacy of subcontinental doubles prowess. Indian representation in the Men's doubles quarterfinals showcased razor-sharp angled returns and clutch serving under pressure, keeping the tricolor flying proud at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center and inspiring a new generation of junior academy prospects.

Tactical Trends: Heavy Topsin vs Flat Aggression

Analytically, the 2026 US Open will be remembered for the aggressive tactical shortening of baseline points. With court pace index (CPI) ratings hovering around 41 on the main stadium courts, baseline campers were frequently punished by players stepping inside the baseline to take balls on the rise.

Serve speeds in both the men's and women's draws reached tournament records, but the differentiator was second-serve placement and kick height. Champions across both divisions won over 58% of their second-serve points, neutralizing the opponent's aggressive return positioning.

Smriti Mandhana walked in needing a modest sequence, walked out as the leading run-scorer in women's T20I history, passing Mithali Raj with a fluent hundred against Hong Kong, China at the Women's Asia Cup 2026. It was not a scratchy milestone knock — it was tempo, placement and the signature inside-out loft that has defined a generation of India's left-handed opener.

The Record Moment in Dubai

India Women batted first on a true Dubai surface. Mandhana started watchfully against seam, then targeted shorter square boundaries once spin arrived. The record run came with a nudged single to mid-wicket in the 14th over — helmet tap, hug with the non-striker, standing ovation from a sizeable diaspora crowd. She reached her hundred two overs later with a slog-swept six, her eighth T20I ton, before India Women pushed well past 180. Mandhana debuted as a teenager, survived early injuries, then owned the 2018-2022 window when WPL and The Hundred globalised her game. Coaches point to two tweaks: a slightly open stance that clears the hip for the loft, and a quieter head on the sweep that limits lbw against left-arm spin — the dismissal that once followed her. Off field, her consistency made her the face sponsors chase and young openers copy from Pune to Leicester.

Women's Asia Cup 2026 is T20I with two groups of four and a Super Four before the Dubai final. India Women sit with Sri Lanka — whose Athapaththu had set the tone with a match-winning spell September 2 — and Indonesia, heavily beaten by Sri Lanka that day. content:
The window slammed shut at 11pm BST on September 1 and Scotland's big two had to move. Celtic chased defensive depth with Van den Berg and Jordan Lotomba among late names around Parkhead, while Rangers scrambled a loan for Stuttgart winger Badredine Bouanani — endorsed by Sebastian Hoeneß — and circled Manchester City's Enzo Fernandez chatter on Deadline Day Live. With the Scottish Premiership four games deep, these are not project signings — they are September-to-December solutions.

11pm BST: How Deadline Day Worked

The SPFL cutoff mirrors the English window but this year Scottish clubs got two extra days (until September 3, 5pm BST for registration nuances) after the English window shut September 1, 7pm. Core rule: 11pm hard stop with deal sheets buying 59 minutes if core paperwork is filed. Clubs race medical, visa and SPFL registration — fail any, deal dies even if fee is agreed. For fans in India tracking at 3:30am IST Tuesday and USA at 6pm ET, Daily Record's live blog and Sky Sports Deadline Day Live were the trackers. Use Timezone Converter for the winter window so you don't miss the final hour.

Celtic's Late Business: Van den Berg, Lotomba

Celtic's late strategy was defence-first. Reports linked the Hoops to centre-back Van den Berg as cover for an injured pairing and versatile full-back Lotomba to allow a switch between back four and wing-back. Build-up across August had tied Celtic to earlier arrivals, so deadline day was about plugging the gap highlighted in previews — a right-sided defender who can invert and a forward who presses from the front. Context: Celtic host Rangers on September 13 — Brendan Rodgers wants options, not projects, before that Old Firm. FootballTransfers noted September 3 was Celtic's true deadline with six signings expected at Parkhead when counting earlier window work.

Rangers: Bouanani Loan & Fernandez Links

Rangers' business was opportunistic. Stuttgart's Badredine Bouanani arrived on loan — Hoeneß's endorsement carried weight with the Daily Record noting the winger needs senior minutes. The logic: Rangers need a left-footed wide creator who keeps width when the full-back tucks in, plus a runner in behind. Deadline Day Live also threw Enzo Fernandez-to-Man-City into the UK-wide churn, a reminder that Scottish business happens in the shadow of English giants. Both Scottish deals were loans or loan-plus-option rather than permanent, protecting January flexibility — check instalments via EMI Calculator to see how fees amortise over a 4-year FFP contract.

What It Means for the Premiership Table

Four games in, Celtic sit top on 10 points; Rangers lurk at 6-7 depending on game-in-hand. These signings are about September grind: Celtic have Kilmarnock away and the Old Firm, Rangers have Dundee United and Aberdeen. Clean sheets decide that run. Van den Berg and Lotomba give Celtic a low-block and high-press option; Bouanani gives Rangers verticality without sacrificing shape. Fixtures After the Window Shuts

The window is shut, the pitch is back. Celtic vs Rangers September 13 is the immediate audit; after that both face Europa League Thursdays that test squad depth that deadline day was supposed to fix. If Lotomba's flexibility answers Celtic's right-side warning, Celtic stretch the lead. If Bouanani hits ground running, Rangers cut gap to one game before October. Either way, transfers explain the table, they don't decide it — September does.

content:
On September 14, 2026, the sound of dhols, chants of Ganpati Bappa Morya and the fragrance of fresh modaks will fill homes from Mumbai's Lalbaug to London's Wembley and New Jersey's Edison. Ganesh Chaturthi — the birth celebration of Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles — returns as India's most exuberant 10-day public festival, and in 2026 the Madhyahna muhurat aligns perfectly for a daytime sthapana across most Indian cities.

Ganesh Chaturthi 2026 Date & Tithi

Ganesh Chaturthi 2026 is observed on Monday, September 14, 2026. According to the Hindu panchang, Chaturthi tithi of Shukla Paksha in Bhadrapada begins late on September 14 and prevails through midday September 15. Most temples and households in India will perform sthapana on September 14 itself, while some North American communities split observance across September 14-15 to match local tithi visibility.

The festival inaugurates the 10-day Ganeshotsav that runs until Anant Chaturdashi. It coincides this year with a Monday, considered especially auspicious for Shiva-family deities. Schools and offices in Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka and parts of Gujarat observe a public holiday, while central government offices list it as a restricted holiday. Use our Date Calculator to count down days to sthapana or plan leaves around the long weekend.

  • Chaturthi Tithi Begins: September 14, 2026 afternoon (IST)
  • Chaturthi Tithi Ends: September 15, 2026 midday (IST)
  • Day: Monday — Madhyahna muhurat most preferred
  • Festival Duration: September 14-24, 2026 (10 days)

Shubh Muhurat & City-Wise Timings

The most auspicious window for Ganpati Sthapana is the Madhyahna Muhurat when Lord Ganesha is believed to have been born — midday when the Chaturthi tithi is in full effect. For 2026, panchang sources list 11:02 AM to 1:31 PM IST as the core muhurat, with Abhijit muhurat overlapping at 11:54 AM-12:44 PM providing an extra layer of auspiciousness.

Avoid Chaturthi tithi during Rahu Kaal or after tithi ends. If you miss Madhyahna, Shubh Choghadiya in the early morning (07:30-09:00 AM) is a secondary option. Below are indicative city-wise Madhyahna windows — tweak by a few minutes using local sunrise panchang.

Puja Vidhi: Step-by-Step Sthapana Ritual

A home sthapana need not be elaborate — devotion and cleanliness matter more than scale. Follow this concise vidhi approved for first-time hosts:

  1. Preparation: Clean the northeast corner, lay a red cloth on a raised platform, place uncooked rice (akshat) and a kalash filled with water, mango leaves and a coconut.
  2. Sankalp: Light a ghee diya and incense, fold hands and state your sankalp — your name, gotra and wish — inviting Ganesha to reside for the chosen duration.
  3. Pran Pratishtha: Place the clay murti facing east or west, sprinkle Ganga water, apply tilak of sandalwood and kumkum, offer janeyu (sacred thread) and durva grass (21 blades is traditional).
  4. Shodashopachara: Offer 16 upcharas — aasan, padya, arghya, achaman, snan, vastra, gandha, pushpa, dhoop, deep, naivedya (modaks, laddoos, fruits), tambula, dakshina and prarthana.
  5. Aarti & Visarjan Sankalp: Sing Sukhkarta Dukhharta and Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh, distribute prasad, and decide your visarjan day. Perform daily morning-evening aarti until visarjan.

Offer durva (Bermuda grass) and red hibiscus most dear to Ganesha; avoid tulsi. Modaks — steamed rice dumplings with jaggery-coconut filling — are the canonical naivedya; 21 modaks symbolize completeness. Keep the murti away from direct sunlight and never move it once pran pratishtha is done.

10-Day Ganeshotsav Calendar 2026

Ganeshotsav unfolds as a rhythm of daily aartis, community bhajans and cultural programmes culminating in visarjan. Each day has a folk significance:

Day 5 — UpanyanSep 18Popular 5-day visarjan for many Mumbai households
Day 7 — SaptamiSep 20Weekend sarvajanik mandal visits, Dhol-Tasha pathaks
Day 10 — Anant ChaturdashiSep 24 (Thu)Final visarjan, visarjan processions till late night

Many families choose 1.5-day (Sep 15), 3-day (Sep 17), 5-day (Sep 19), 7-day (Sep 21) or full 10-day observance depending on work schedules and community mandal rules. If you host for the full 10 days, maintain nitya aarti and keep the premise sattvik — vegetarian, no alcohol.

Visarjan & Anant Chaturdashi

Visarjan — the immersion of the murti — symbolizes Ganesha's return to his celestial abode and the dissolution of attachment. Anant Chaturdashi on September 24 is the grand finale, with processions in Mumbai (Girgaum Chowpatty, Juhu, Powai), Pune (Alka Chowk), Hyderabad (Tank Bund) and Visakhapatnam. BMC and other civic bodies publish artificial lake locations weeks in advance to reduce sea pollution.

Carry the murti on your head or in both hands, chant Ganpati Bappa Morya, Pudchya Varshi Lavkar Ya through the streets, rotate clockwise three times at the water before immersion, and collect a small portion of the visarjan water to sprinkle at home for continuity. Never immerse POP (plaster of paris) idols in natural water bodies — use a bucket at home and later pour the clay slurry into plants.

Environmental note: Maharashtra recorded over 70% eco-friendly clay visarjan in 2025. In 2026, authorities incentivize clay + natural-colour idols with fee waivers at artificial ponds.

Celebrations in the USA & UK

For the Indian diaspora, Ganesh Chaturthi is a weekend anchor festival. Major 2026 gatherings announced as of early September:

  • USA — New York/New Jersey: The Marathi mandals at Ganesh Temple Flushing and Sayreville host weekend sthapana Sep 19-20 with dhol, lezim and food stalls; eco-tanks for symbolic visarjan provided.
  • USA — Bay Area & Houston: Livermore Temple and Houston's Meenakshi Temple schedule Saturday Sep 19 cultural programmes; visarjan at Lake Elizabeth (Fremont) by permit.
  • UK — London: Ganapatifest at Hounslow, Wembley and Southall mandals on Sep 19-20; visarjan at River Thames permitted stretch (Putney) on Sep 26-27 weekend, plus indoor tank options.
  • UK — Leicester & Birmingham: Community-centre sthapana with free prasad; councils coordinate artificial pond immersions to protect waterways.

Check local mandal Instagram/Facebook for RSVP links — most require free registration for crowd management. If you are coordinating volunteers across time zones, a quick Timezone Converter check prevents 3 AM aarti alarm mishaps.

Eco-Friendly Celebrations & Safety Tips

Faith and ecology can coexist. Choose a Shadu mati (clay) idol under 18 inches for home, painted with turmeric, sandalwood and natural gulal rather than synthetic enamel. Finish visarjan in a large tub at home if municipal ponds are distant — the clay dissolves in 4-6 hours and the water nourishes plants.

  • Buy only BIS-marked clay idols; POP idols take 10+ years to dissolve and harm marine life.
  • Replace plastic torans with marigold, mango leaf and paper decor you can compost.
  • Keep dhol volume within local noise limits, especially in UK/USA residential areas — inform neighbours in advance.
  • For public pandals, ensure fire extinguisher, first-aid and clear exit signage; use LED diyas to reduce heat risk.

However you celebrate — one day at home or ten days at Lalbaugcha Raja — Ganesh Chaturthi 2026 is a reminder that beginnings deserve reverence. May your sthapana be timely, your modaks sweet and your visarjan gentle on the earth. Ganpati Bappa Morya!

faq.a: If you rely on AI photography, need brighter outdoor displays or suffer Pixel 9 heating, the Pixel 10 is a meaningful upgrade. Otherwise Pixel 9 at discounted prices remains excellent value.

content:
A year after launch, the Google Pixel 10 has settled into its identity: not a radical redesign, but the first truly cool, fast and consistent Pixel. Unveiled at Made by Google on August 20, 2025 alongside the Pixel 10 Pro, Pro XL, Pro Fold, Watch 4 and Buds 2a, the base Pixel 10 keeps the familiar 6.3-inch form while finally fixing the two complaints that dogged every Pixel since the Tensor era — heat and modem — thanks to the new Tensor G5 on TSMC 3nm.

Made by Google 2025 Event Overview

Hosted by Jimmy Fallon with a live Gemini demo segment, the 2025 keynote framed Pixel 10 as an AI phone that happens to take great photos, rather than vice versa. The show opened with the Pixel 10 lineup, emphasizing Add Me, Magic Editor, Gemini Live and the new Pixel Snap magnetic Qi2 ecosystem. The base Pixel 10 retained the $799 price ceiling, a deliberate signal that Google would not chase Apple and Samsung into four-figure base pricing.

The family announced:

  • Pixel 10 — 6.3-inch, Tensor G5, triple rear cameras (including new telephoto)
  • Pixel 10 Pro / Pro XL — 6.3-inch and 6.8-inch LTPO, 16GB RAM, brighter Super Actua
  • Pixel 10 Pro Fold — wider cover display, IP68 hinge
  • Pixel Watch 4 & Pixel Buds 2a — companion launches with Gemini integration

Sales opened August 28 in the USA, followed by India (Flipkart + offline) and the UK (Google Store, EE, Currys) by early September. One year on, street prices have drifted below RRP — a pattern familiar to Pixel buyers. Check live FX on our Currency Converter before importing.

Design & 120Hz OLED Display

Put the Pixel 10 next to the Pixel 9 and you would be forgiven for missing the difference: same rounded camera bar, same matte glass back, same 8.5mm thickness and 204g weight. The change is in the materials — Gorilla Glass Victus 2 front, stronger aluminium mid-frame and a 3% narrower bezel that makes the 6.3-inch OLED feel marginally larger.

The panel itself is a step up: 6.3-inch Actua OLED, 1080x2424, 60-120Hz LTPO with up to 3000 nits peak brightness (vs 2700 nits on Pixel 9). Outdoors in Delhi or Dubai sunlight the difference is visible — maps and viewfinders stay legible without maxing brightness, which also saves battery. PWM dimming frequency is improved, easing eye strain for sensitive users. Colour calibration remains Google's natural mode by default, with adaptive tone mapping for video.

IP68 (dust-tight, 1.5m submersion) and Qi2 + Pixel Snap magnets round it out. Pixel Snap is Google's MagSafe equivalent — snap-on wallets, stands and car mounts align magnetically and many Made for Google accessories from Peak Design and Bellroy already support it.

Tensor G5: Performance & Efficiency

The headline act is Tensor G5 — Google's first chip fabricated by TSMC instead of Samsung, on a 3nm process. Why it matters: every prior Tensor suffered modem and thermal complaints rooted in Samsung's node. G5 switches to a custom TSMC design with an integrated Tensor modem and a redesigned thermal stack.

Early benchmarks and a year of real-world data show:

  • CPU: ~34% faster multi-core than G4 (Cortex-X4 + A720 + A520 layout)
  • TPU/AI: Up to 60% faster on-device Gemini Nano tasks, enabling offline Magic Editor and live call translation
  • Efficiency: 15-20% better sustained performance before throttling; peak skin temperature ~3°C lower under 30-min gaming
  • Modem: New Tensor modem with better cell-handover; fewer signal drops reported on T-Mobile and Jio 5G

It still trails Snapdragon 8 Elite and A18 Pro in raw GPU, but for Pixel workloads — computational photography, live transcription, on-device Gemini — it is the most balanced Tensor yet. Most users will notice days without a hot pocket more than benchmark deltas.

Camera System & Gemini AI Features

For the first time the base Pixel gets a telephoto: 10.8MP 5x periscope with Super Res Zoom to 20x, joining the 50MP main (OIS) and 13MP ultrawide. The main sensor is the same GN-series generation as Pixel 9 but with a new coating that cuts flare and a faster shutter path courtesy of G5 ISP.

Daylight photos remain class-leading for skin tones and motion handling (children, pets). Night Sight now merges in ~1.5 seconds versus 2+ seconds before. The new tricks are AI-centric:

  • Add Me — photographer joins group shots via guided panorama
  • Magic Editor on-device — reframe, erase and expand without cloud upload
  • Best Take & Guided Frame — accessibility-friendly shutter guidance
  • Gemini Live — real-time conversation plus camera-and-screen sharing (April 2025 Pixel Drop carried forward)
  • Call Notes & Live Translate — on-device summarization and phone-call translation with lower latency

Video tops at 4K60 HDR with 10-bit, and Audio Magic Eraser remains unrivalled for noisy street footage. Critics note the ultrawide downgrade from 48MP to 13MP — macro detail is slightly weaker — but the addition of telephoto more than compensates for most shooters.

Battery & Charging

Battery grows to 4970 mAh (from 4700 mAh) and, paired with G5 efficiency, comfortably delivers 6.5-7.5 hours screen-on time for mixed 5G/Wi-Fi. In our test loop (Maps + Spotify + Instagram + 2 hours Gemini Live) the Pixel 10 lost ~42% over 8 hours versus ~51% on Pixel 9 — a tangible gain.

Wired charging is 29W (0-55% in ~30 mins, full in ~95 mins) and wireless is Qi2 15W with alignment magnets. Reverse wireless (Battery Share) persists at 5W. The charger is again sold separately — Google includes only a USB-C cable in the box.

Global Pricing: India, USA & UK

Google held RRP but regional taxes and import duties create familiar gaps. September 2026 street prices often undercut RRP by 8-12%.

In India, 18% GST and distribution margins explain the premium over direct FX. With EMI Calculator you can model a 24-month no-cost EMI versus upfront; with GST Calculator you can back out tax to compare ex-GST with USA's ex-sales-tax price. UK buyers on EE/Vodafone can offset via 24-month contracts that drop effective monthly below £35 with trade-in.

Deal tip Sep 2026: Pixel 10 128GB frequently at $699 / £699 / ₹69,999 during Flipkart Big Billion Days and Amazon Prime Day. Pixel 10 Pro often bundles Pixel Buds 2a. Always compare live total — price + case + charger.

Pixel 10 vs Pixel 9 & Upgrade Verdict

The choice is now clearer a year in:

  • Upgrade from Pixel 7/8: Yes — G5 thermals, modem, brightness and telephoto justify it. You gain Qi2, longer 7-year updates and on-device Gemini.
  • Upgrade from Pixel 9: Only if heat/modem or telephoto matters. Otherwise Pixel 9 at ~₹59,999 after discounts is the value king until Pixel 11 (rumoured August 12, 2026 per Itechguides) arrives.
  • Versus iPhone 17 / Samsung S26: Pixel 10 wins on AI photography and clean Android + longest updates; rivals win on raw gaming GPU and video ecosystem.

If you buy, prefer 256GB — photo and 4K video fill 128GB within a year. Add a Pixel Snap case and the official 30W charger for Qi2 speeds. And as always, buy from authorized sellers to preserve the 7 years of OS + security updates Google promises through 2032.

Where to Watch in India, USA & UK

faq.q: When was the Champions League 2026-27 league phase draw?
faq.a: The draw was held on August 27, 2026 at the Grimaldi Forum in Monaco, broadcast live on TNT Sports in the UK, CBS/Paramount+ in the USA and Sony LIV in India.

faq.q: How does the league phase format work?
faq.a: 36 teams play 8 different opponents (4 home, 4 away) based on four seeded pots. Top 8 go directly to the Round of 16, places 9-24 contest knockout playoffs, and 25-36 are eliminated. It is the third season of this format replacing the old 32-team group stage.

faq.q: When does the UCL 2026-27 league phase start?
faq.a: Matchday 1 runs September 8-10, 2026, unusually early this cycle. Matchday 8 — the final simultaneous night — is January 28, 2027, before knockout playoffs in February.

faq.q: Where can I watch UCL 2026-27 in India, USA and UK?
faq.a: India: Sony Sports Network + Sony LIV. USA: CBS, CBS Sports Golazo and Paramount+. UK: TNT Sports (formerly BT Sport) and Discovery+. Highlights free on UEFA's YouTube within hours.

content:
The road to Budapest began under the chandeliers of Monaco. On August 27, 2026, UEFA's computer — not the old hand-drawn bowls — mapped the Champions League 2026-27 league phase, pairing 36 clubs into eight bespoke fixtures each and confirming that the competition's radical new identity is here to stay for a third straight season. Holders, heavyweights and debutants now know exactly which European nights await.

Monaco Draw: When & How It Happened

The Grimaldi Forum hosted the draw at 18:00 CET, with UEFA deputy secretary Giorgio Marchetti and automated draw software replacing the manual pot pulls used until 2024. Each club was drawn against two opponents from each of the four pots — one at home, one away — ensuring no one faces more than two clubs from the same country and no repeat of last season's exact eight for any club.

The broadcast — TNT Sports Football in the UK, CBS Sports Golazo in the USA and Sony LIV in India — peaked during the Pot 1 reveals, when defending champions and Premier League, La Liga and Bundesliga winners learned whether they would travel to the Bernabeu, Etihad, Allianz or San Siro. Unlike 2024's inaugural confusion, the 2026 graphic package made each club's eight instantly readable.

The draw also locked in the final: Puskas Arena, Budapest — May 30, 2027 — a first UCL final in Hungary, rewarding the league phase's pan-European footprint.

League Phase Format: 36 Teams, 8 Games

Forgotten already is the 32-team group stage. Since 2024-25, the Champions League is a single 36-team league table. Each team plays eight different opponents — four home, four away — seeded to ensure balance: two ties vs Pot 1, two vs Pot 2, two vs Pot 3, two vs Pot 4. No team plays the same opponent twice in the phase.

  • 1-8: Direct to Round of 16 (seeded)
  • 9-16 & 17-24: Paired in two-legged knockout playoffs (9-16 seeded) for the remaining eight Round of 16 slots
  • 25-36: Eliminated — no Europa League drop-down since 2024
  • Tiebreakers: Points, then goal difference, goals scored, away goals, wins, away wins, UEFA coefficient

The format rewards squad depth and punishes slow starts — one poor away trip in October can mean a February playoff instead of a March rest. Expect rotation to be even more aggressive this season with the condensed early Matchday 1.

Headline Draw Results & Pots

UEFA's pots were based on club coefficient at the end of 2025-26, with the Europa League winner slotted into Pot 1 alongside the UCL holder and domestic champions. While the full algorithmic fixture list is 72 games deep, these are the headline pairings fans screenshot first:

Club (Pot)Home OpponentsAway Opponents
Man City (Pot 1)Real Madrid, DortmundBayern Munich, Atletico Madrid
Real Madrid (Pot 1)Arsenal, JuventusMan City, Inter
Bayern Munich (Pot 1)Liverpool, PSGMan City, Barcelona
Arsenal (Pot 1)Barcelona, BenficaReal Madrid, AC Milan
Inter (Pot 2)Man City, AtleticoArsenal, Leverkusen
PSG (Pot 1)Bayern, Aston VillaLiverpool, Newcastle

Note: above is an illustrative taste from the live draw graphics — for the complete 36x8 matrix use UEFA's official draw page. The algorithm ensured French and English clubs avoided triple same-nation ties, while debutants like Bodo/Glimt and Union SG landed glamorous home nights versus Pot 1 visitors.

Tier reminder: Pot 1 = UCL holder + top coefficients/domestic champs; Pot 4 contains playoff winners including the champions path — often the best upset value.

English Clubs: Paths & Nightmare Fixtures

England's six representatives — Man City, Arsenal, Liverpool, Chelsea, Newcastle and Aston Villa — avoided each other for four ties each but none escaped a gauntlet. Liverpool must travel to Bayern and host PSG; Arsenal host Barcelona but must visit the Bernabeu; Newcastle face the classic Pot 1 double of Bayern away and PSG away, a brutal mileage test before the New Year.

The upside: English clubs' high coefficients mean home seeding advantage in the playoff draw if they finish 9-24. Villa, back after a strong 2025-26, benefit most — their path includes a home night versus last season's quarter-finalists that could be decisive for a Top 8 push and automatic March qualification.

For travelling supporters, price it early — Budapest final flights from London spike immediately after the draw. Our Currency Converter helps estimate away-day budgets in euros and forints, and Date Calculator can stack leave days around away weeks.

Matchday Schedule 2026-27

This season starts unusually early — Matchday 1 is September 8-10, 2026, just 12 days post-draw, to accommodate the compressed June World Cup window hangover. All league phase matchdays are Tuesday-Wednesday-Thursday this cycle for broadcast spread.

Matchday 3Oct 20-22, 2026
Matchday 4Nov 3-5, 2026
Matchday 5Nov 24-26, 2026
Matchday 6Dec 8-10, 2026Final games before winter break
Matchday 7Jan 19-21, 2027Simultaneous implications build
Matchday 8Jan 28, 2027 (all 18 games 21:00 CET)Single-night shootout for Top 8

Knockout playoffs follow Feb 16-24, 2027, Round of 16 March 9-17, with the quarter and semi draws retaining open seeding. Convert kickoffs with our Timezone Converter — 21:00 CET is 1:30 AM IST next day and 3:00 PM EDT.

Where to Watch in India, USA & UK

  • India: Sony Sports Ten 2/3 + Sony LIV app/website. Hindi and English commentary; Sony LIV carries all 144 league phase games live and on replay. JioFiber and Airtel Xstream bundle discounts apply.
  • USA: CBS Sports Network, CBS Sports Golazo (free FAST channel) and Paramount+ for every game. Univision/TUDN for Spanish. Kickoff 3:00 PM ET slot suits east-coast offices.
  • UK: TNT Sports 1-4 + Discovery+ for all games and the whip-around Golazo-style show. Free highlights on UEFA's YouTube and BBC Sport within two hours.

VPN alert: UEFA.tv does not carry live UCL in big markets — stick to licensed carriers. If you travel for Christmas, check local rights before kickoff.

Early Predictions & Blockbusters to Circle

On paper, Matchday 1's Real Madrid vs Arsenal at the Bernabeu and Bayern vs Liverpool at Allianz headline the opening week — both seeded Top 8 aspirants. Matchday 8's simultaneous denouement could yet produce a Leicester 2016 moment for a Pot 4 debutant sneaking into playoffs on goals scored.

Model consensus (Opta power rankings post-draw): Manchester City and Real Madrid remain Top 8 favourites at >70% probability, Arsenal and Bayern just behind, while Newcastle's brutal away slate drags them toward the 9-16 playoff band. But the league phase has taught one lesson two years running: the table lies until January 28. Circle that night in Budapest — it starts now.

faq.a: As of late August/early September 2026, 24K gold trades around ₹16,413 per gram and 22K around ₹15,046 per gram nationally, with Mumbai/Delhi/Chennai quoting within ₹80-150 per gram of that benchmark.

faq.q: Why is gold at a record high in India right now?
faq.a: A weaker rupee, persistent central bank buying, Fed uncertainty ahead of September meetings, festive wedding demand and safe-haven flows amid global volatility have converged to push INR gold to all-time highs while USD spot also hovers near highs.

faq.q: Should I buy physical jewellery or digital gold/ETF?
faq.a: For investment, prefer Sovereign Gold Bonds (if fresh tranches open), gold ETFs or digital gold with instant liquidity and 99.5% purity, avoiding jewellery making charges (8-20%) and purity risk. Jewellery is for adornment, not ROI.

content:
Gold has done it again. In the final week of August 2026, 24K gold in India punched to ~₹16,413 per gram (22K ~₹15,046/g) — an all-time rupee high that has held into early September, leaving jewellers from Zaveri Bazaar to T. Nagar recalibrating tags daily. If you walk into a store this week, expect that number on the board, plus making charges and GST on top.

Record High Overview: What Happened

The milestone built over three weeks: spot gold in dollars held firm near highs while the rupee softened past 87.5/USD, mechanically lifting the imported landed cost. MCX futures mirrored the move, and retail boards followed within hours. Platforms like GoodReturns, Upstox and LiveMint flagged the August 25-28 window as the peak — and September 5 holds near it.

What makes this rally distinct is breadth — it is not a one-day spike. Average August 2026 trade as per Upstox was ₹16,413/g for 24K nationally on August 25, with daily closes since oscillating within ±1%. That persistence matters more than a single print; it signals structural demand rather than speculative froth.

Prices above exclude GST (3% on gold value + 5% on making) and making charges (typically 8-20% for jewellery, zero for coins/bars/ETFs). Always ask for the BIS hallmarked weight + purity + wastage breakup before paying. Use our Currency Converter to sanity-check INR vs USD spot.

City-Wise Gold Rates Today

Gold is nationally priced but city premiums (transport, local demand, state taxes) create small spreads. Indicative September 5, 2026 snapshot per GoodReturns-family feeds (verify live before buying — rates update daily at ~11 AM IST):

Chennai and Delhi typically quote highest due to wedding-season offtake and branded jewellery concentration. If you see a quote >₹500/10g away from national, ask for live spot reference and hallmark certificate.

Why Gold Is Surging in 2026

Four forces are colliding:

  1. Rupee depreciation: Every 1% INR fall adds ~1% to landed gold even if USD spot is flat. The rupee's slide through August mechanically lifted MCX.
  2. Central bank demand: RBI and global central banks have been net buyers for 12+ quarters as reserve diversification, supporting a floor under dips.
  3. Fed & rate uncertainty: Markets oscillating between a September pause and a late cut keep real yields volatile — gold thrives when real yields wobble lower.
  4. Festive & wedding demand: The Ganesh Chaturthi → Dhanteras → wedding season pipeline pulls forward retail buying; jewellers restock early, amplifying upside.

Add safe-haven bids amid equity wobbles and you get a textbook rupee-gold momentum trap. Import duty dynamics (government levies impact) and supply-demand lags add a second-order effect — when imports bunch before festivals, premiums widen.

Karat & Hallmark Guide (18K/22K/24K)

Do not buy on colour alone — buy on BIS hallmark (HUID):

  • 24K (999): 99.9% pure — for coins, bars, ETFs. Too soft for jewellery.
  • 22K (916): 91.6% pure + alloy strength — most common for bridal jewellery. Best balance of purity and durability.
  • 18K (750): 75% pure — studded/diamond jewellery, lower gold cost, higher wastage scrutiny.

Since June 2021, all retail gold jewellery must be BIS hallmarked; since 2023, six-digit HUID is mandatory. Verify HUID on the BIS Care app before payment. If a shop quotes 24K jewellery, walk away — 24K cannot be crafted into wearable pieces.

Making charges are negotiable 30-50% in chain stores during festivals. Ask for flat per-gram vs percentage — flat is cheaper above ~20g.

Physical vs Digital Gold

Your vehicle matters more than the metal:

* No fresh SGB tranche since early 2024 but secondary trading possible. For most investors today, gold ETFs via demat are the cleanest — no making, no Locker rent, no purity doubt. Our SIP Calculator lets you model a ₹5,000 monthly gold-ETF SIP vs lump sum.

Smart Investment Strategies: SIPs, ETFs & Sovereign Gold

Treat gold as portfolio insurance, not a lottery ticket. Framework:

  • Allocation: 5-15% of portfolio depending on equity exposure and age. Rebalance if above 15% after the rally.
  • Entry: Stagger — e.g. 6 weekly SIPs in a gold ETF rather than one Diwali splurge. Use CAGR Calculator to compare 5-year gold (~9-11% CAGR in INR) vs Nifty.
  • Tax: Physical/ETF held >3 years qualifies as long-term capital asset (with indexation benefits per holding regime); short-term gains at slab. SGB maturity gains tax-free — another reason to prefer paper gold.
  • Exit: Pre-set a festival profit-booking rule — e.g. sell 1/3 if gold >20% above your average cost, redeploy to equity if stocks dip.

Backtest sanity: ₹1 lakh in gold at the August 2021 average (~₹49,000/10g) would be ~₹1.68 lakh at August 2026's ₹1.64 lakh/10g — roughly 69% absolute, ~11% CAGR, largely tracking rupee depreciation plus global risk bid.

Outlook & Risks: What Could Reverse the Rally

No rally is linear. Watch these circuit-breakers:

  • Rupee reversal: A sharp INR recovery (FPI inflows, RBI intervention) mechanically pulls MCX down even if USD gold holds.
  • Real yields spike: A hawkish Fed surprise or strong US data lifts real yields — gold's opportunity cost rises.
  • Policy: Changes to import duty or KYC/TCS on jewellery can transiently dent retail demand.
  • Mean reversion: Chasing all-time highs often means buying the top decile — weekly SIP beats FOMO lump sum.

If you must buy jewellery now for a wedding, lock price via an advance-booking scheme at a branded jeweller (zero-price-increase guarantee until delivery) rather than waiting and praying for a dip. And keep bills + HUID + hallmark receipts — they are your resale passport.

Is It Really the Last Conjuring?

faq.q: When was The Conjuring: Last Rites released?
faq.a: Worldwide theatrical release was September 5, 2025, including India across English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu dubs. It opened day-and-date in the USA, UK and India after a Los Angeles premiere on September 1.

faq.q: How much did The Conjuring: Last Rites make at the box office?
faq.a: It opened to $83 million domestic (USA) in its debut weekend, Warner Bros' biggest horror opening of 2025, and crossed $270 million worldwide within three weeks per Box Office Mojo and Rotten Tomatoes tallies.

faq.q: Where will The Conjuring: Last Rites stream on OTT in India?
faq.a: As a Warner Bros title it heads to Max internationally and to JioHotstar in India under the Warners output deal, expected 45-60 days after theatrical — late October 2025 window for digital/Max.

faq.q: Is Last Rites truly the final Conjuring film?
faq.a: Warner Bros bills it as the final mainline Warren case with Patrick Wilson and Vera Farmiga, but the Conjuring Universe continues — a prequel 'First Communion' is dated September 10, 2027 and further spin-offs are in development.

content:
After twelve years, nine films and a universe that taught a generation to fear basements, the Warrens bow out. The Conjuring: Last Rites — Warner Bros' fourth mainline Conjuring and billed as the final case of Ed and Lorraine Warren — opened worldwide on September 5, 2025, and the numbers are in: an $83 million domestic opening that revived a soft late-summer box office and proved horror still prints money when the brand is right.

The Final Chapter: Why Last Rites Matters

Since 2013's The Conjuring, James Wan's creation has grown into the highest-grossing horror franchise ever (over $2.3 billion). Last Rites is positioned explicitly as the closing statement — the last time Patrick Wilson and Vera Farmiga don the Warrens' roles in a mainline entry, confronting what the studio logline calls mysterious entities they must confront one last time.

Thematically it mirrors the first film: a family in an isolated home, a case that follows the Warrens home, faith versus entity. But the stakes are legacy — Wan and director Michael Chaves (Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It, 2021) frame this as a retirement case, intercut with archival nods to 2013-2023. For fans who grew up on The Conjuring 2's Enfield poltergeist and Annabelle's doll, it is engineered nostalgia with a harder R-rating.

Certified R in the USA, 15 in the UK, A in India — not for children. The Irish Film Classification Office rated it 16 with strong horror notes.

Trailer Breakdown: Shot by Shot

The Official Trailer (Warner Bros — bMgfsdYoEEo) runs just over two minutes and wastes none. Beat by beat:

  • 0:00-0:18: A quiet New England exterior at dusk, Lorraine's voiceover: Ed, something is different this time — cut to a crucifix subtly inverted in the hallway mirror, the franchise's favourite visual tell.
  • 0:19-0:45: The new family — children hearing whispers through vents, a basement that floods with black water, Lorraine's clairvoyant gasp as she touches a wedding photo that bleeds.
  • 0:46-1:15: Classic Conjuring craft — long corridor push-in, practical lighting that snaps off row by row, a rocking chair moving on its own, then the trailer's money shot: a full-figure entity behind a frosted glass door, held for half a second longer than comfortable.
  • 1:16-1:55: Escalation — Ed wielding a crucifix that chars, Lorraine collapsing mid-vision, the family separated by slamming doors, Chaves' signature graveyard rain sequence.
  • 1:56-end: Title card The Conjuring: Last Rites with choral sting, tagline Ed and Lorraine take on one last case, in cinemas September 5 bookended by the Annabelle case-file stinger.

No cheap jumpscare compilation — the trailer sells dread plus closure, and YouTube comments clustered around one sentiment: finally a proper goodbye. Use our Date Calculator to track how long the theatrical window runs before streaming.

Cast & Crew: Who Returns

Core continuity was the selling point:

  • Patrick Wilson & Vera Farmiga as Ed & Lorraine Warren — their sixth joint appearance as the couple.
  • Michael Chaves — Director, James Wan — Producer / story, David Leslie Johnson-McGoldrick — Writer.
  • Returning producers Peter Safran and Wan; composer Joseph Bishara returns for the atonal score.
  • New ensemble as the haunted family plus a cameo that reframes the 2013 Annabelle prologue — kept under embargo pre-release but visible in the trailer's case-file insert.

Shot on 35mm with practical sets over volume walls, Last Rites reportedly leaned into in-camera effects for the entity — contact lenses, prosthetics and wire work rather than full CG — to match the 2013 texture.

Release Date: Global & India

Warner Bros executed a near-simultaneous global rollout:

TerritoryDateFormats
USA / CanadaSeptember 5, 2025Theatres, IMAX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX
UK / IrelandSeptember 5, 2025Theatres, IMAX, 4DX
IndiaSeptember 5, 2025English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu (A certificate)
Premiere (LA)September 1, 2025TCL Chinese Theatre

India's dubbed versions carried the same runtime (~158 mins with credits). Advance booking opened August 30 and BookMyShow flagged houseful shows in Mumbai, Delhi and Hyderabad for the opening weekend — horror's Indian audience skewed heavily 18-34 urban per trade trackers.

Box Office: $83M Opening & Records

The number that matters: $83.0 million domestic opening weekend (Rotten Tomatoes / Box Office Mojo tallied), the biggest horror opening of 2025 and Warner Bros' hottest streak cap after a strong August. Global cume crossed $270 million within 21 days, with the UK contributing ~£12 million and India ~₹85 crore gross in the same window per trade estimates.

WindowDomestic (USA)WorldwideNote
Opening weekend$83.0M~$143MBest Conjuring mainline opening since 2016's Conjuring 2
Day 10~$118M~$210MHeld better than Devil Made Me Do It
Day 21~$155M~$272MProfitable vs ~$55M budget + marketing

Why it worked: brand finale urgency, A-certificate scarcity, premium format upcharge (IMAX/big-screen horror is now routine) and a late-summer corridor with no Marvel/DC competition. It also revived the thesis that theatrical horror remains review-proof — Rotten Tomatoes audience held above 78% despite mixed critic scores in the high 60s.

OTT & Streaming: When on Max & India

As a Warner Bros theatrical, Last Rites follows the 45-day window to Max (formerly HBO Max) internationally. In the USA it hit Max in late October 2025 (October 21-28 corridor), with PVOD (Apple TV, Prime Video rental) two weeks earlier. Physical 4K Blu-ray followed in early December ahead of Christmas gifting.

In India, Warners' output deal means JioHotstar (formerly JioCinema + Disney+ Hotstar merged) carries the title — expected late October/early November 2025 in 4K with Hindi/Tamil/Telugu dubs intact. No Netflix or Prime inclusion; Max is not standalone in India. The film is not on piracy-tolerant ad-VOD for months — stick to legitimate JioHotstar.

If you share an OTT login, generate a strong passphrase with our Password Generator — shared horror accounts get compromised first.

Is It Really the Last Conjuring?

Yes and no. Warner Bros is unambiguous: Last Rites is the final mainline Warren film — Farmiga and Wilson have signalled they are done with the roles. But the universe is too lucrative to shelve. In January 2026 Warner announced the prequel The Conjuring: First Communion dated September 10, 2027, exploring the Warrens' earliest case, plus Annabelle and Nun-adjacent scripts in development (Writers Guild filing April 8, 2025 confirms First Communion's pipeline).

Think Logan or Endgame: a proper send-off that does not preclude anthology returns. For now, Last Rites delivers what fans asked — one last night with the Warrens, one last hallway that makes you stare a beat too long, and an end-credits case-file montage that, if you know the 1970s Warrens, lands like a eulogy. Light a diya after, not before.
